english.note: Use 碼 as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the unit of length.

examples.english: This rope is a yard long.
examples.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sing4 jau5 jat1 maa5 coeng4

english.note: Use 碼 for a numbered or lettered clothing or shoe size, especially in ordinary shopping talk.

examples.english: Do these shoes come in size 42?
examples.jyutping: nei1 deoi3 haai4 jau5 mou5 sei3 sap6 ji6 maa5
